6. **Steven saw Nancy walking in the garden from 7pm to 9pm**: This period is from 7pm to 9pm.

Now, we need to find the time when Nancy was available to go to the movies. The movies were closed after 9pm, so we need to look at the times from 5pm to 9pm.

- From 5pm to 6pm: This is the only time when Nancy was not available to go to the movies.
- From 6pm to 7pm: This is the only time when Nancy was available to go to the movies.

Answer: (B) 6pm to 7pm
